adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`, the code directly dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without guarding or using `params.require(:embeddable_host)`. If a client sends a malformed request missing the `embeddable_host` key (or it’s filtered out), this will raise `NoMethodError` and 500 the request instead of returning a controlled 4xx error. This risk is present in the diff-added controller at lines assigning `host.host` and `host.category_id`.
